description: Cheapest GPU machines for rent right now across Vast.ai, RunPod, Nebius, CoreWeave, Lambda, OVHcloud, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, ranked by price. Returns price per hour, provider, country, tier (datacenter or community host), reliability score, whether the price is interruptible (spot), and grid carbon intensity where an open data feed covers the host's grid (Europe and GB live; US by state or cloud region, a day old). Can filter and sort by carbon. AWS, Azure and Nebius are covered with on-demand prices (providers aws, azure, nebius) and spot prices (aws_spot, azure_spot, nebius_spot); Google Cloud with spot prices only (gcp_spot); CoreWeave with on-demand list prices of whole 8-GPU nodes (coreweave); Lambda and OVHcloud with on-demand list prices (lambda, ovh). Data is refreshed hourly; `observed_at` is the snapshot time. Read-only, free, no account.

continents.description: Only hosts on these continents, e.g. ['europe']. Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean are north_america; Turkey and the Middle East are asia. Combined with region_filter or us_states, a host in any of the places listed matches.

data_at.description: Where the dataset sits now, as cloud:region, e.g. 'aws:us-east-1', 'azure:eastus', 'gcp:us-central1'. With data_gb, every offer gets the cost of moving the data to it (data_transfer): free in the same region of the same cloud, the inter-region rate elsewhere in that cloud, the internet egress rate to any other provider.

data_gb.description: Size of the dataset to move, GB. Needs data_at.

gpu_class.description: GPU model, e.g. RTX4090, RTX5090, H100, H200, A100_80, A100_40, L40S, A6000, RTX3090, L4, T4. Loose forms like '4090' or 'RTX 4090' work.

hours.description: How long the machine is needed, hours. With data_at and data_gb, each offer gets job_total_usd (machine hours plus the data transfer) and the search ranks by it.

include_interruptible.description: Omit (default) to get on-demand prices plus AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Nebius spot, which are real prices for a running machine. true also adds Vast.ai / RunPod minimum bids, which are a floor rather than the price of keeping the machine. false drops everything interruptible, cloud spot included (which removes Google Cloud entirely: it is listed with spot prices only).

jobs.description: How many times the dataset will be needed at a machine outside the cloud it is in (separate runs, possibly at different providers). Used with data_at for the staging comparison: paying the cloud's egress every time, or once into storage that is free to read from.

limit.description: Maximum offers returned, in sort_by order. total_matching gives the full count.

max_carbon_g_kwh.description: Only hosts on a grid at or below this carbon intensity, gCO2eq/kWh. Offers with no carbon value are dropped when this is set.

max_price_hr.description: Upper bound on USD per hour for the whole machine

min_reliability.description: Drop hosts whose provider reliability score (0..1, Vast.ai only) is below this. Offers with no score are kept. 0 shows every host.

months.description: Over how many months those jobs run; a staging copy is stored for that long.

providers.description: Only these providers. Default: all. aws, azure, nebius, coreweave, lambda and ovh are on-demand prices; aws_spot, azure_spot, nebius_spot and gcp_spot are spot prices, so combined with include_interruptible=false those four return nothing. Google Cloud has no on-demand prices here.

region_filter.description: Only hosts in these ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries, e.g. ['US','DE']. Hosts with unknown country are excluded. For a whole continent use continents; for US states use us_states.

sort_by.description: price: cheapest per hour first. carbon: lowest grid carbon intensity first, cheapest within the same grid; offers with no carbon value go last. total: lowest cost of the whole job first (hours of the machine plus moving the data there); needs data_at, data_gb and hours, and is the default when all three are given.

tier.description: datacenter keeps only hosts the provider lists as datacenters and drops community hosts (independent hosts on a marketplace)

us_states.description: Only hosts in these US states, two-letter codes, e.g. ['TX','CA'] (DC counts as a state). Narrows 'US' if region_filter also lists it. Cloud regions are placed in the state the provider documents (AWS us-east-1 is VA). A US host whose state is unknown, and providers that publish no location (lambda, coreweave, runpod), never match.

name: find_offers

alternatives.description: Only when the class asked for is a consumer card that no cloud rents out (RTX 4090, 5090, 3090: marketplaces only) and the search asked for a cloud provider, or for a datacenter and found none: datacenter cards with at least as much memory per GPU, same GPU count, cheapest on-demand price first. Search one with gpu_class.

provider.description: Provider of the cheapest on-demand offer

providers.description: Every cloud listing this class on demand at this GPU count

observed_at.description: UTC time of the price snapshot (ISO 8601)

break_even_hours.description: Only when stay_put is given: hours of running after which this offer's lower hourly price has paid for the data transfer. null when it is not cheaper per hour than staying put; 0 when the transfer is free.

carbon_g_kwh.description: Grid carbon intensity at the host, gCO2eq/kWh. null when no open feed covers that grid.

carbon_lag_h.description: Age of the carbon value in hours. 0-3 is live; 24 or 48 means the same hour of day one or two days earlier (US).

carbon_uncertain.description: true when a tenth or more of that grid's generation was reported without a fuel type, so the carbon value rests partly on an assumed mix. Say so if you quote it.

data_transfer.description: Only with data_at and data_gb: moving the dataset to this offer's machine, at the source cloud's list prices.

hours.description: Time to copy at a sustained 1 Gbit/s; real links vary widely

route.description: same_region: same cloud and region, free. same_cloud: another region of the cloud the data is in, its inter-region rate. internet: any other provider, the cloud's internet egress rate.

usd.description: One copy of the dataset, USD

est_gco2_per_hr.description: Rough estimate, grams CO2eq per hour of running this machine: carbon_g_kwh x nameplate GPU power x gpu_count. GPUs only, full load, not measured.

gpu_class.description: Canonical class, e.g. RTX4090, H100_SXM, A100_80

grid_zone.description: Grid zone the carbon value is for, e.g. NO-NO1, SE-SE3, US-TEX-ERCO. Vast.ai gives only the country outside the US, so countries with several zones use one default zone (Norway NO1, Sweden SE3, Denmark DK1, Italy north) and the host may be in another; US states map to their main grid operator.

interruptible.description: Spot or bid price; the machine can be taken back

job_total_usd.description: Only with data_at, data_gb and hours: price_usd_hr x hours + data_transfer.usd

region.description: Provider region or datacenter id; US state or Canadian province for Vast.ai hosts

state.description: US state, two-letter code, when the host is in the US and its state is known

stock.description: RunPod only: its own stock level for this GPU and tier, high / medium / low. Null elsewhere: a Vast.ai row is itself one machine free to rent, and the clouds publish no availability.

tier.description: datacenter: the provider lists the host as a datacenter. community: an independent host on a marketplace, anything from one person's PC to a small server room; the provider does not say which, so do not describe it as a home computer.

staging.description: Only with data_at: what it costs to take the dataset out of its cloud `jobs` times over `months`, paid every time (direct_usd) or once into a staging copy, object storage that charges nothing to read out, which any provider's machine can then pull from. Offers' data_transfer and job_total_usd are for one direct move and do not include this.

egress_once_usd.description: One copy out of the cloud at its internet egress rate

free_reads_per_month.description: Reads free up to this many times the stored size a month; null: no limit published

pays_back_from_moves.description: Number of moves from which the staging copy is cheaper than paying egress each time, at these months

read_usd.description: Charge for reads beyond the free allowance, over all the months

total_usd.description: egress_once_usd + storage for the months + read_usd

stay_put.description: Only with data_at: the cheapest on-demand machine of this class and GPU count in the region the data is in, where the data moves for free. null when that cloud does not list the class there. It is a list price, not a machine confirmed free.

title: Find GPU rental offers
